why_trail.why: Handoff-g5 verified complete; seams confirmed against source: session_estimator.py estimate_session() line ~115 loads with literal Q, ~125 sets m=quali_mass(year) unconditionally; estimate_batch.run_estimate_batch omits session_type from its estimate_fn(...) call; estimate_store_fields.py owns _axis_statuses/_support_trust_profile/effective_axis_sigma/UNRESOLVED_AXIS_SIGMA_FRAC; mass_model.fp_mass and fp_lap_latent.extract_fp_lap_latent (G2) are ready to reuse. Plan m1-m4 will wire session_type through, resolve FP mass via fp_lap_latent's fastest-clean-lap, widen cda/p_max/b_b/b_t via the existing unresolved-status machinery, and produce a real 2023 FP smoke fit.

estimate_session now takes session_type/mass_kg/mass_sigma_kg/db_path; line ~115 load literal flipped to session_type; mass resolution is a 3-way priority (injected > FP via fp_lap_latent fastest-clean-lap > quali_mass) via new _resolve_session_mass/_resolve_fp_mass/_fastest_clean_lap helpers; SessionEstimate carries mass_sigma_kg. 21 new tests green, genuine RED confirmed via git-stash. Q byte-identical by construction: default session_type='Q' takes the exact old branch (quali_mass(year), sigma=None) and the exact old load literal.

run_estimate_batch now passes session_type=session_type into estimate_fn(...) (was silently omitted, the exact bug the handoff named). Updated the two duck-typed fakes in test_estimate_batch.py to accept-and-ignore session_type (mirrors the existing hp_store precedent in test_backfill_estimate_store.py). 6/6 batch tests green.

_axis_statuses now accepts session_type and reads est.mass_sigma_kg: for FP sessions with a real mass_sigma_kg it forces cda/p_max/b_b/b_t unresolved (reusing the existing resolved/unresolved + effective_axis_sigma/UNRESOLVED_AXIS_SIGMA_FRAC machinery -- no parallel sigma formula), leaving a_b/a_t/A0/A2 untouched (grip-anchor/mass-cancelling axes). _support_trust_profile splits its non-Q reason: FP gets practice_session_fp_mass_uncertainty, other non-Q/non-FP keeps practice_session_quali_mass_assumption (still accurate there, since only FP got the fp_mass fix). estimate_store.py threads session_type into _axis_statuses and adds mass_sigma_kg_assumed (self-heals via existing ALTER-add migration). Updated the old FP-reason assertion + added 8 new tests (widening, non-widening cases, degenerate-composition, non-FP-non-Q wording split, round-trip). 55/55 estimate_store tests green.

Targeted region (21 new FP tests + 6 estimate_batch + 55 estimate_store = 82) green together; simplification_limits --baseline PASS on all 7 touched files; git status --short data/ clean. Live 2023 telemetry smoke fit did not complete in reasonable time (heavy 5-view fit against the 55GB cache, confirmed running not crashed) -- deferred to G7's bounded real-compute batch per the handoff's own no-real-backfill posture; substituted a fast structural verification (real fp_mass/quali_mass/record_from_estimate/effective_axis_sigma/_axis_statuses against a duck-typed SessionEstimate) showing FP mass_kg=835.5 != Q mass_kg=808.0, and effective_axis_sigma(CdA) widening from 0.112 (Q) to 1.15 (FP) while grip axes (a_b/a_t/A0/A2) stay resolved. IMPLEMENTER_RESULT written to result-g5-implement.md with the full disposition documented as a stop-condition-partial, not a silent gap.
